title: Gravitational radiation
summary: Transverse-traceless waves and the two polarisations; the effect on test bodies via proper separation and geodesic deviation; the quadrupole formula; waves on a general background, the non-locality of wave energy and the radiated power.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.962 Lectures 16–17 (Lecture Guide pages 4–5), Tong Chapter 5 and Carroll Chapter 6.

preparation.description: Read the Lecture Guide's synopsis of Lecture 16 (PDF page 4): transverse-traceless waves, h+ and h×, geodesic deviation, the quadrupole formula.
Read the Lecture Guide's synopsis of Lecture 17 (PDF page 5): waves on a general background, non-locality of gravitational-wave energy, second-order perturbation theory and radiated power.
Watch Lectures 16 and 17 from the video gallery (transcripts on each lecture page).
Second account: Tong, General Relativity, Chapter 5 When Gravity is Weak (reference-only), the sections on gravitational waves.
Optional: Carroll, Chapter 6 Weak Fields and Gravitational Radiation (second half), reference-only.
